Our Story – Parth & Garima

How we met 💗

It’s funny how our story started long before we even knew what love was.

With our fathers being friends, we grew up seeing each other at family parties and gatherings.

I remember that kashmir trip when we enjoyed alot. Making memories together without having any idea of what life had planned for us.

Who would’ve thought that the girl I grew up meeting at parties and all, would one day become someone so incredibly important to me?

And honestly, if I could go back to those days, I’d probably smile knowing that someday, all those little moments with you would turn into the most beautiful love story of my life.

Our first long call 🫂

i remember like after so many months of texting you finally called me, just to study fine arts from me😂, funniest part mujhe khud kuch nhi aata tha or na hee tumhe kuch samajh aaya😂 still first time tumhari awaz sunkar ohho kya sukoon tha abhi tak dimag me hai

then few days back we created a new record 😂 of our call like we literally talked for 3hrs bina bore hue also mai bol rha tha bas tum to text par thi bas still apan bore nhi hue, this shows how connected we actually are.

The moment I knew 💗

Actually i remember every moment with you whether it’s good or not. One of the best moment was like jaipur me jab we met in park, and apan ne walk krte krte itani saari baate kri and at last ache se day finish kiya maine tumhe jab godi me uthaya tha, that was one of the best feeling of my life and at last you hug me for a photo and last me mera tight wala hug…uffff. I crave every moment with you like i pray it never lasts, may our love never gets weaks and we never bored of each other.

A memory I love 🫂

I love every single second that i spend with you from every choti choti ladai to mere liye choti choti baato par care krna. Breakfast done? Lunch kar liya? Dinner abhi tak kyu nhi kiya? Everything matters to me alot.

Still us 💗🫂

Maybe our countries are different but our hearts are same, care for each other is same, love for each other is same, jealousy level is same, thought are same, insecurity level is same, everything is same ig we are made for each other🫢😉.
